note_tweet.text:
More than 100 kg of genuine gold ornaments have been used to adorn Goddess Durga and other idols at a gold-themed Durga Puja pandal in Siliguri, West Bengal. Inaugurated by BJP MP from Jalpaiguri, Dr Jayanta Roy, the pandal features golden-themed decorations that complement the gold-adorned idols, drawing large numbers of devotees. Meanwhile, Kolkata’s Ahiritola Sarbojanin Durga Pandal celebrates North Kolkata’s rich cultural legacy through its history of milk distribution and traditional sweet-making, bringing together faith, folk culture and generations of culinary traditions.
